verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 grid is verified to 4m RMSE
OS Terrain 50 is a bare-earth DTM rather than a surface-object model
grid/contour supply is organized in 10km by 10km tiles
grid height values are given to nearest 0.1m
grid metadata includes spatial and vertical reference information
metadata identifies British National Grid EPSG:27700 and Ordnance Datum Newlyn EPSG:5701
tile metadata can record earliest and latest flying dates
GML feature and geometry identifiers are unique for a release and are regenerated on whole-tile refresh
OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation
OSTN15 uses a 1km transformation grid and bilinear interpolation
OSTN15 agreement with archived OSGB36 points averages better than 0.1m RMSE
OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoid heights to orthometric heights including ODN on mainland Britain
OSGM15 uses a 1km grid with bilinear interpolation
OSGM15 nominal geoid accuracy is 8mm RMS in mainland UK
quality_effect: Pins independent coarse-terrain evidence to explicit tile epoch, CRS, vertical datum and transformation provenance; prevents 50m Terrain 50 from being misused as parcel-grade elevation.
